8.- PROCEDURES FOR EXERCISE AIRCRAFT: 
8.1.- EXERCISE ACFT WILL FLY VFR/VMC IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO 
RULES AND PROCEDURES AS AMPLIFIED IN AIP-GREECE. 
8.2.- EXERCISE ACFT WILL SUBMIT FLIGHT PLANS AND WILL NOT ENTER 
CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, UNLESS PRIOR PERMISSION HAS BEEN OBTAINED BY 
APPROPRIATE ATS UNITS. 
9.- PROCEDURES FOR NON EXERCISE ACFT: 
9.1.- IN THE INTEREST OF SAFETY DURING THE EXERCISE, NON EXERCISE 
ACFT ARE STRONGLY ADVISED NOT TO FLY WITHIN THE AREAS 
DESIGNATED IN PARAS (1) TO END PART 2 OF 3
